Package eu.algites.lib.factory.cpdiscovery.impl.standard

Class AIcCategoryProviderRegistry

java.lang.Object
eu.algites.lib.factory.cpdiscovery.impl.standard.AIcCategoryProviderRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
eu.algites.lib.factory.cpdiscovery.AIiCategoryProviderRegistry
public final class AIcCategoryProviderRegistry extends Object implements eu.algites.lib.factory.cpdiscovery.AIiCategoryProviderRegistry
Atomic catalog of service-loader factories and provider defaults. Registration replaces immutable snapshots, so lookups do not acquire the write lock. A removed source may still be referenced by a lookup already in progress.
